title: 06 · Security settings and audit log · Ferrule
pattern: settings: security, SSO and audit log
strengths: An engineer's SAML form in a believable half-done state: 'Verify a domain first' with the last TXT check time and 'Check now', ACS URL and entity ID in mono with Copy, an 'e.g.' metadata placeholder, and separate Turn on / Require switches disabled with their consequences stated

Every policy names its effect and who it applies to ('Members without it set it up at their next sign-in and can't run queries until then. SAML sign-ins are exempt. 12 members haven't set it up.'); SCIM gated by a quiet 'Available on Enterprise' label, not a banner

The audit log has realistic actors (people, a service account, an API key, a system bot, vendor support under access grant SA-2291), mono event codes, documentation-range IPs with city and country, UTC times with seconds and a UTC/Local switch, a stated 90-day retention, and one row expanded into a log entry with a before/after diff that matches the Security frame's 'Last changed 13:58 UTC'
slop_signals: Saturated plum toggles are the loudest thing on a calm page
The invented customer 'Kestrel Mutual' reuses the showcase's flagship fictional company name 'Kestrel'
fixes: Rename Kestrel Mutual (Kestrel is the showcase's main fictional company, heroes/10 has Kestrel Bay Hospitals, and Kestrel Group is a real listed specialty insurer) and Amara Lindqvist (Lindqvist is in heroes/10 and app-screens/05)
Rename the 'etl-nightly' API key or move its export to night time; it runs at 13:22 UTC
Say why 'Email sign-in link' is off while 'Used by 6 members in the last 30 days' (for example 'Turned off Oct 9')

references.what: SAML metadata URL plus separate Enable and Enforce toggles with consequences; ours adds the domain prerequisite and copyable SP values
Consequence lines per security setting ('This only applies to non-SSO accounts'); ours matches
Audit log with actor, event, description and IP; ours adds event codes, geo, UTC switch and an expanded key-value entry

fixed: API key 'etl-nightly' (running at 13:22 UTC) renamed 'claims-archive', matching what it does
Email sign-in link: 'Turned off Oct 9; 6 members used it in the 30 days before.'
Sign-in methods add up: password is the only method on, so 'All 214 members use it now' (was '31 members', leaving 183 with no way in); 'Require SAML' now says 'Password sign-in stops'
Names: Kestrel Mutual → Larchfield Mutual (larchfieldmutual.com, tile L); Amara Lindqvist (AL) → Amara Sjöberg (AS); tomas.becker@ → jakob.hensel@
'1,284 events' (a number also in the hero and Quoin) is now 1,146
